segments.label: Sinsa Station exit 8 east along Dosan-daero to the foot of Garosu-gil (pedestrian router on OSM streets)
Garosu-gil, the whole tree-lined street north to Apgujeong-ro (OSM way 529594105)

pins.name: Start – Sinsa Station exit 8 (신사역 8번 출구)
pins.desc: Line 3 and the Sinbundang line. Walk east along Dosan-daero for 250 m; Garosu-gil is the first big tree-lined street on the left.

pins.name: Garosu-gil (가로수길)
pins.desc: The 700 m avenue of ginkgo trees from Dosan-daero to Apgujeong-ro: flagship fashion stores, brunch cafés and the Apple Store on the street itself; the quieter boutiques and bakeries are in the side lanes, Serosu-gil, one block west and east. Busiest on weekend afternoons; the ginkgo turns yellow in early November.

pins.name: End – north end of Garosu-gil at Apgujeong-ro (가로수길 북쪽 끝, 압구정로)
pins.desc: Garosu-gil meets Apgujeong-ro here; the Naver link opens the Hyundai High School main gate just across the road. Apgujeong Station (line 3) is 10 min east along Apgujeong-ro; Dosan Park is 15 min south-east.

layers.name: Han River: Banpo Bridge fountain & Sevit Island (반포대교 · 세빛섬)

pins.name: Banpo Bridge Moonlight Rainbow Fountain (반포대교 달빛무지개분수)
pins.desc: 1,140 m of water jets along both sides of Banpo Bridge, lit in colour to music: the longest bridge fountain in the world. Watch from the lawn of Banpo Hangang Park below the bridge or from Sevit Island. Shows run 15 March to October, 20 minutes each: 12:00, 19:30, 20:00, 20:30, 21:00, plus 21:30 from June to September. Cancelled in wind over 7 m/s, rain or muddy river water. From Express Bus Terminal Station (lines 3, 7, 9) exit 8-1 it is a 15 min walk through the underpass to the park.

pins.name: Sevit Island (세빛섬)
pins.desc: Three floating islands moored at the south bank just west of Banpo Bridge, with cafés, restaurants and a convention hall, all lit up after dark. The best close-up view of the fountain is from the walkway between the islands. Free to walk around; open all day.
